title: Beyond Cropped Regions: New Benchmark and Corresponding Baseline for Chinese Scene Text Retrieval in Diverse Layouts
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical challenges of Chinese Scene Text Retrieval, specifically addressing diverse layouts like vertical and cross-line text. It introduces a new benchmark (DL-CSVTR) and a model (CSTR-CLIP) to improve retrieval accuracy. There is no evaluation or benchmarking of religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
